title: Automotive Locksmith Service
excerpt: Mobile automotive key and lock service across Philadelphia with 24/7 availability.
intro: Planetlocksmiths focuses on mobile automotive locksmith work: car lockouts, lost keys, replacement keys, fob needs, programming support, and ignition-related key issues.

sections.heading: Mobile-only support
sections.body: Service is dispatched to the vehicle location instead of routing customers to a shop.

sections.heading: Built around vehicle key problems
sections.body: The workflow starts with the vehicle make, model, location, and key issue so the technician can prepare for the right job.

faq.question: Is this residential locksmith service?
faq.answer: No. The service focus is automotive.

faq.question: Can I request same-day help?
faq.answer: Yes. Same-day requests are supported based on availability.
